BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

A few things
worth knowing.

A smoother visit starts with the little details.

How do I book a room?

Choose a room and your dates, add your contact details, then send your request on WhatsApp. Our team will confirm availability, the final rate and any booking requirements. A request alone does not confirm your booking.

Can I visit the spa without staying overnight?

Yes. Choose “Spa & day visit” in the booking form to request a sauna, steam, massage or gym visit. The team will confirm session times and prices.

What time can I check in or check out?

Please share your preferred arrival and departure times in your request. Eden will confirm check-in and check-out arrangements, including any early or late requests.

How do payments and cancellations work?

Ask the team to confirm payment methods, any deposit, and cancellation terms before committing to your stay. These details are confirmed directly with Eden.

Where is Eden located?

Find us on Mawanda Road in Mulago, Kampala. Use the map link below, or call +256 700 339 077 for the exact entrance and directions.
